name: Moong Sprout and Tofu Chaat
steps: Steam or boil sprouts for 5–7 minutes until thoroughly hot and tender; drain well.
Pat tofu dry. Heat oil in a non-stick pan and lightly brown tofu cubes on two sides.
Combine warm sprouts, tofu, tomato, cucumber and onion in a bowl.
Season with cumin, chaat masala, lemon and salt; toss gently.
Finish with coriander and serve promptly.
note: Cook sprouts thoroughly rather than serving raw, particularly for people at higher risk of foodborne illness.
